Report Description/// THIS IS A CORRECTION TO NRC REPORT 1413972 /// /// THE CORRECTION IS AS FOLLOWS /// THE PREVIOUS REPORT LISTED THE INCIDENT DATE AS OCTOBER 1. THIS REPORT CORRECTS THAT TO OCTOBER 14. /// ORIGINAL REPORT BELOW /// /// 48 HR PHMSA UPDATE TO INCIDENT REPORT # 1413804 /// UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: - THE INJURED PARTIES WERE EVALUATED AT THE HOSPITAL AND RELEASED WITH MINOR INJURIES. - THE EXPLOSION OCCURRED IN A UNDERGROUND ELECTRICAL DUCT BANK DUE TO UNKNOWN REASONS. - THE INVESTIGATION IS STILL UNDERWAY. - EAST ORANGE POLICE AND FIRE ALONG WITH NJ BOARD OF PUBLIC UTILITIES WERE ON SCENE AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT. READINGS ALL CLEAR AT OTHER LOCATIONS. 3 PEOPLE HOSPITALIZED, 1 HELD OVER NIGHT FOR OBSERVATION, 2 RELEASED.

properties.title: NRC Report: #1 Arctic Grade Diesel Fuel near Fairbanks, AK
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 809999 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: ALASKA VILLAGE ELECTRIC COOP.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 809999
Incident Time: 2006-08-31 14:30:00
Nearest City: Fairbanks, AK
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: #1 ARCTIC GRADE DIESEL FUEL
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: ALASKA VILLAGE ELECTRIC COOP.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 54 gallons
///WEB REPORT/// AFTER DAYTANK FILLING OPERATIONS (LOGGED AT 9:10 PM 8/30/06) THE PLANT OPERATOR DID NOT VALVE OFF THE LINE FROM THE BULK TANK TO THE DAYTANK. HEAD PRESSURE FROM THE BULK TANK OVER FILLED THE DAYTANK AND FORCED FUEL THROUGH POORLY SEALED THREADS AROUND THE TANK GUAGE AT THE TOP OF THE TANK. #1 ARCTIC GRADE FUEL OIL SEEPED THROUGH THE THREADS, RAN DOWN THE TANK ONTO THE CONCRETE FLOOR AND SPREAD OUT AGAINST THE WALL OF THE METAL BUILDING. FUEL SEEPED UNDER THE WALL AND INTO THE SOIL ALONG THE BUILDING FOUNDATION. WE HAVE RECOVERED (4) 55 GALLON DRUMS OF CONTAMINATED SOIL AND ARE STILL DIGGING DOWN IN GRAVELY SOIL. THE LIMITS OF THE TRENCH ARE 20 FEET LONG, 10" WIDE AND 2 FEET DEEP. AN ESTIMATE OF FUEL LOST HAS NOT BEEN DETERMINED BUT IS EXPECTED TO BE LESS THAN 55 GALLONS.

CALLER STATED THAT THEY LOADED A TANK CAR IN OLD OCEAN TEXAS WITH 29,249 GALLONS OF HEXANE. THE CAR WAS SEALED AND RELEASED TO THE RAILROAD COMPANY TO BE DELIVERED TO CUSTOMER IN ROCKVILLE MD. THEREFORE THE PRODUCT WAS LOST SOMEWHERE IN BETWEEN LITTLE ROCK AND ROCKVILLE, MD. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE MATERIAL WAS RELEASED TO THE ENVIRONMENT.
